rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a business sector or trade.

example.english: Competition in this industry has been fierce in recent years.
example.traditional: 呢個行業近年競爭好大。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hong4 jip6 gan6 nin4 ging3 zang1 hou2 daai6

rows.note: Use this for the industrial or manufacturing sector rather than a service or other general sector.

example.english: Hong Kong's industry was once thriving.
example.traditional: 香港以前嘅工業好興盛。
example.jyutping: hoeng1 gong2 ji5 cin4 ge3 gung1 jip6 hou2 hing1 sing6

rows.note: Use this formal noun for persistent diligence or hard work.

example.traditional: 佢多年嘅勤勉終於得到回報。
example.jyutping: keoi5 do1 nin4 ge3 kan4 min5 zung1 jyu1 dak1 dou2 wui4 bou3
